entry.title: DINXXL 1.0.0
entry.summary: BlastBeats (Twisted Electrons) v7.1 firmware, unmodified, as an Akai Force / MPC OS 3.x plugin by L'Cronx, with the BlastBeats factory card inside. Install: unzip and follow INSTALL.md (the installer restarts MPC). Rough edges expected; send card/dinxxl.log with bug reports. GPL-3.0-or-later for L'Cronx code; BlastBeats firmware (c) Twisted Electrons, see NOTICE and README.
